fullPassage: The ancient Greeks felt that the visual artist’s goal was to copy visual experience. This approach appears in the realism of ancient Greek sculpture and pottery. We must sadly note that, due to the action of time and weather, no paintings from ancient Greek artists exist today. We can only surmise their quality based on tales such as that of Zeuxis and Parhassios, the obvious skill in ancient Greek sculpture, and in drawings that survive on ancient Greek pottery. This definition of art as copying reality has a problem, though. Jackson Pollock, a leader in the New York School of the 1950’s, intentionally did not copy existing objects in his art. While painting these works, Pollock and his fellow artists would consciously avoid making marks or passages that resembled recognizable objects. They succeeded at making artwork that did not copy anything, thus demonstrating that the ancient Greek view of art as mimesis ― simple copying ― does not sufficiently define art.

det.analysis:
빈칸은 'does not __________ define art'에서 동사 define(정의하다)을 꾸며 주는 자리예요. 동사를 꾸미는 말은 부사이므로, 형용사 sufficient(충분한)를 부사 형태로 바꿔야 해요.

형용사 뒤에 -ly를 붙이면 부사가 되므로 sufficient → sufficiently(충분히)가 돼요. 'does not sufficiently define art'는 '예술을 충분히 정의하지 못한다'는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: sufficient(형용사) → sufficiently(부사): 동사(define)를 꾸미는 자리

questions.passage: The ancient Greeks felt that the visual artist’s goal was to copy visual experience. This approach appears in the realism of ancient Greek sculpture and pottery. We must sadly note that, due to the action of time and weather, no paintings from ancient Greek artists exist today. We can only surmise their quality based on tales such as that of Zeuxis and Parhassios, the obvious skill in ancient Greek sculpture, and in drawings that survive on ancient Greek pottery. This definition of art as copying reality has a problem, though. Jackson Pollock, a leader in the New York School of the 1950’s, intentionally did not copy existing objects in his art. While painting these works, Pollock and his fellow artists would consciously avoid making marks or passages that resembled recognizable objects. They succeeded at making artwork that did not copy anything, thus demonstrating that __________ ― simple copying ― does not sufficiently define art.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

"예술을 미메시스(모방)로 보는 고대 그리스의 관점" (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) ancient, art, as, Greek, mimesis, of, the, view 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: the ancient Greek view of art as mimesis
det.analysis:
핵심 명사는 '관점'을 뜻하는 view이고, 정관사 the와 형용사 ancient Greek이 앞에서 꾸며 the ancient Greek view(고대 그리스의 관점)로 써요.

무엇에 대한 관점인지는 전치사 of로 연결하고, '예술을 미메시스로 보는'은 'view of A as B(A를 B로 보는 관점)' 구조를 활용해 of art as mimesis(예술을 미메시스로 보는)로 나타내요. 여기서 as는 '~로(서)'라는 뜻이에요.

순서대로 이으면 the / ancient / Greek / view / of / art / as / mimesis.
det.tip: view of A as B = A를 B로 보는 관점 (as = ~로서)

accept: the ancient Greek view of art as mimesis

다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"제욱시스와 파라시오스의 이야기와 같은 (그런) 설화들"

[ and / as / of / Parhassios / such / tales / that / Zeuxis ] (8단어) (영어로)

det.korean: tales such as that of Zeuxis and Parhassios
det.analysis:
핵심 명사는 '설화들'을 뜻하는 tales이고, '~와 같은'은 such as로 나타내요. 그래서 tales such as(~와 같은 설화들)로 시작해요.

'제욱시스와 파라시오스의 이야기(그것)'는 앞의 tale을 대신 받는 that을 써서 that of Zeuxis and Parhassios(제욱시스와 파라시오스의 그것)로 표현해요. 여기서 that은 반복되는 tale을 대신하는 지시대명사예요.

순서대로 이으면 tales / such / as / that / of / Zeuxis / and / Parhassios.
det.tip: such as that of A and B = A와 B의 그것(이야기)과 같은 (that = 앞 명사 대신)

"(이 접근법은) 고대 그리스 조각과 도자기의 사실주의에서 나타난다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) ancient, and, appears, Greek, in, of, pottery, realism, sculpture, the 을 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: appears in the realism of ancient Greek sculpture and pottery
det.analysis:
동사는 '나타난다'를 뜻하는 appears예요. 주어(This approach)가 3인칭 단수라 -s가 붙은 appears가 쓰였어요. 어디에 나타나는지는 전치사 in으로 이어 in the realism(사실주의에서)으로 써요.

무엇의 사실주의인지는 of로 연결해 of ancient Greek sculpture and pottery(고대 그리스 조각과 도자기의)로 나타내요. sculpture와 pottery는 and로 나란히 이어요.

순서대로 이으면 appears / in / the / realism / of / ancient / Greek / sculpture / and / pottery.
det.tip: appears in the realism of ~ = ~의 사실주의에서 나타난다 / A and B로 두 대상 병렬
